directionSummary: The existing quiet clinic information sheet translated to your requested dark mode: plum-tinted charcoal, warm off-white text, and sparse light muted plum headings. Preserve all current content, typography, spacing, layout, and static behavior; no new assets or features.

brand.mood: Calm and immediately legible, clearly a fictional deployment-test listing rather than an operating care service.

palette.strategy: Restrained dark equivalent of the original warm-paper/plum identity. Light muted plum occupies less than 10% of the surface; no pure white or black. Surface matches the canvas; no new panels.
palette.theme: Fixed dark mode regardless of system preference; native color-scheme dark. No toggle, theme persistence, or light variant.

semantic.success: Unused; do not invent success status.
semantic.warning: Unused; sample-data notice is ordinary readable text.
semantic.error: Unused; closed weekend hours are not an error state.
semantic.info: Use warm off-white main text for the sample-data notice, not a colored badge.

typography.display: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif; title 36–56px, weight 600, line-height 1.1, tracking -0.025em
typography.body: Same system humanist sans stack; 16–18px, weight 400, line-height 1.5–1.6
notes: Section headings 20–24px at weight 600; field labels may use 14px at weight 500.
Use at least 1.25 scale contrast between body, section headings, and title.
Left-align text; maximum reading width 65ch; notice text at least 14px.
No external font request or downloaded typography asset.

layout.direction: Flat document canvas with a restrained, left-aligned typographic hierarchy.
layout.navigation: None. Single public page without a menu, sidebar, tabs, or sticky header.
layout.density: Comfortably spaced but short; no full-viewport promotional hero.
notes: Viewing scene: phone information lookup and desktop deployment inspection under variable ambient light. Explicit dark-mode preference determines the canvas; prioritize readable contrast.
Desktop vertical padding 64–88px; mobile 32–40px with 24px side gutters.
Clinic name precedes the information area by 40–56px.
Hours and contact use two columns above approximately 640px with a 48–64px gap; stack hours then contact on smaller screens.
Place a visible sample-data notice after the information sections.
Use fine horizontal rules and space instead of cards; do not force viewport filling.
No horizontal scrolling at 320px or 200% zoom; allow normal page scrolling.

surfaces: Flat canvas only; no shadows, glassmorphism, rounded panels, repeated cards, decorative icons, images, or logo assets.
The clinic name is the page identity.
forms: None. No inputs, contact form, search, sign-in, or data collection.
actions: No call-to-action buttons, booking, or integrations.
Display fictional contact information as selectable text without operational contact claims.
dataDisplay: Use semantic sections and labeled text or description lists, not a data table or dashboard.
Hours: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM; Saturday–Sunday, closed. Hours are local to the sample clinic.
Notice: Sample information for a deployment test. Not a real clinic listing.
Allow email and address to wrap; no live open/closed badge or map.

principles: Render all information immediately without entrance animations, skeletons, or overlays.
Preserve native selection and zoom behavior.
Any interactive element introduced by a later approved change needs visible keyboard focus and reduced-motion support.

accessibility: WCAG AA text contrast: at least 4.5:1 for normal text and 3:1 for large text; verify final rendered main text, muted labels, notice, and plum headings against the dark canvas. Fine rules are decorative, not the sole means of conveying structure.
One h1, meaningful section headings, semantic reading order matching the layout.
Keep all information readable without remote assets or script-dependent disclosure.
constraints: Exactly one public static page; no additional screens or backend management.

Palette-only revision: preserve current font metrics, spacing, responsive layout, all sample content, and static behavior. No code or backend changes during design; prior HIPAA remediation is outside the theme revision scope.
Do not add a theme toggle, preference storage, system-theme switching, or light-mode variant.
No authentication, MFA, booking, forms, integrations, dashboards, tracking, or collection of personal information.
No invented services, testimonials, credentials, or promotional claims.
No status implying production deployment verification has already succeeded.
Avoid stock medical imagery, generic teal templates, gradients, and oversized heroes.
